commitSpec.description: Whether new specs are committed under docs/specs/ (true), kept local under .super-exec/specs/ (false), or prompted at write time (ask).

commitPlan.description: Whether new plans are committed under docs/specs/ (true), kept local under .super-exec/specs/ (false), or prompted at write time (ask).

humanReviewBeforeCheckpointCommit.description: Whether to require human review before each checkpoint commit (true/false), or prompt at /se-exec start (ask).

autoCreatePr.description: Whether to auto-create a PR (true/false), or prompt at /se-exec start (ask).
